faculty.name: Dr. Plasin Francis Dias
faculty.about: Dr. Plasin Francis Dias is a faculty in Electronics and Communication Engineering. Her research focuses on Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Polarimetry, image processing, signal processing, and VLSI-based implementations for remote sensing applications. Her interests include radar signal analysis, FPGA design, and advanced techniques for Earth observation and environmental monitoring. She has published 18 research papers in reputed journals and conferences and is actively engaged in advanced research and academic activities.
courses_taught: Analog Mixed Mode Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Design
recognition: Research article titled "Entropy Based target Identification in Synthetic Aperture Radar Polarimetry" received Best Paper Award at The 2nd World Summit on Advances in Science, Engineering and Technology, Indiana Summit 2019, Indiana University Perdue University Indianapolis, USA.

Research article titled "Quantitative Approach for Snowy Feature Detection using Polarimetric Analysis" received Best Paper Award at the International Conference on Intelligent Engineering Approach (ICIEA-2022).
Member of Institution of Engineers India (IEI).
Life member of Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE).
Life Member of International Association of Engineers (IAENG).

recognition: Recognized Reviewer for Springer, Elsevier Science, Taylor and Francis, IEEE Transactions, and IET (UK).
